title: API Compatibility Change Auditor
description: Compares two endpoint contracts and flags removed or type-changed fields that need explicit breaking-change handling.
decision: The change is compatible when prior fields remain with the same declared types; removed or changed fields are reported for version and migration review.
inputs: The caller supplies previous and current endpoint-to-field-type maps, plus a declared semantic version change.
limitations: This compares structural field names and types only. It cannot infer behavioral compatibility, wire-level coercion, or every consumer dependency.

input_schema.description: The caller supplies previous and current endpoint-to-field-type maps, plus a declared semantic version change.
